[b]Level Editor User Guide[/b]
[b]Controls[/b]

 - Move the camera using the W, A, S, D keys.

 - Zoom in and out using the NUMPAD +/- keys or the scroll wheel.

 - Place blocks by right-clicking.

 - Rotate placed blocks by middle-clicking.

 - Remove blocks by activating the eraser (slash icon and a circle
in the bottom left) and right-clicking on the block. Deactivate the
eraser by clicking the button shadow again (the button will appear).

- Change the rotation of future placed blocks by clicking the
arrow icon in the bottom left.

- Change future placed blocks by clicking ▶ or ◀

[b]Selection[/b]

 - Select blocks by left-clicking and dragging. Move the selected
blocks using the arrow keys, delete    	them by pressing Delete, and
rotate them by pressing R

 - Add blocks by left-clicking and holding Shift.

 - Remove blocks by left-clicking and holding Ctrl.

 





[b]Blocks[/b]


[b]Nodes[/b]

Nodes are reference points for bots to navigate. They follow nodes
in sequential order (1, 2, 3, etc.) in straight lines. The ranking
system also uses nodes to determine the first place. 


- Place nodes as points to follow. Start from 1 and increase the
number for each subsequent node. 


- Add nodes at road turns, placing them in the center.

- For holes, add a node before the hole and check the 'jump'
toggle.

- To avoid barriers, add nodes beside them so bots will navigate
around them. 


- The last node should have the 'finish' toggle checked so bots
will loop back to the first node.




[b]Checkpoints[/b]

Checkpoints are used for the ranking system and as spawn points
when a player or bot dies.

- Place checkpoints in a straight line, starting from 1. 


- Keep checkpoints away from holes to allow karts to accelerate
and jump. Place them near a node, so a bot can start following the
path again if it fails.

- The last checkpoint should have the 'Finish' checkbox checked,
the highest ID, and be placed near the finish line. Laps are counted
when karts pass this last checkpoint.




[b]Collisions[/b]

Place collisions on the sides of the road to prevent players and
bots from going off the track, even if they jump.





[b]Barriers[/b]

Barriers are obstacles placed on the road. A car can jump on the
barrier to skip it, or steer around it.






[b]Power up[/b]

A power up currently can either speed up or slow down. Id of 0 or
less will make it random (change after every collision) an ID of 1
will set it to only speed up, and 2 will only slow down.






[b]Ramp[/b]

When a car runs over it, it will jump automatically.




[b]Slow[/b]

Stops bots from accelerating whenever its in collision with it.



[b]Colorblock[/b]

Use color blocks to decorate your map with colors. Adjust the
color using the sliders on the left. You can also change the
background color of the entire track using the track config.



[b]TrackConfig[/b]

A block used to save track configurations. Its position is fixed
at 1000x, 1000y.




[b]Track Configuration[/b]

- Laps: Number of laps to complete the race.

- Max Speed: The maximum speed a kart can reach.

- Jump Cool down b: Time in seconds a kart must wait after a jump
before jumping again.

- Acceleration / Deceleration: The amount to increase or decrease
speed per tick.

- Background Color: The background color of the track.

- Load Level: Load a level code into the editor. Type 'Builtin:'
without quotes, followed by a number to load one of the built-in
levels.



[b]Karts spawning[/b]

Place 2 player cars and 5 bot cars.

 Add a new object variable to the trackconf block and change its value from here.
